summary: Not approved; this is not a full-chapter or publication approval. This current packet covers units s0111–s0112 and s0262–s0296: the park-oxen shares and Feng Yu’s remonstrance. The repaired dating holds up. Jinshu gives no year, and ZZTJ 卷097 dates the remonstrance to 永和元年 (AD 345) with no conflicting witness, so AD 345 is supported for Feng Yu, Song Gai and Shi Hu’s present-tense mention. Wang Xian and Liu Ming’s earlier (前者) punishments correctly use onOrBefore AD 345. Murong Hui, 西伯, Ximen and Shi Qi are correctly retrospective, with empty hints, and Yao and Tang are qualitative. One defect remains. 漢祖 in s0271, followed by 明、章, is Guangwu: Hou Hanshu dates the 度田不實 executions to 建武十六年 (AD 40), so p133’s BC 202–195 Gaozu dating (claim-761, claim-807, hints-p133) is incorrect. No owned unit states a birth, death or age. A cosmetic note: the event string ‘dated345by ZZTJ97’ lacks spaces. English: only the en field was supplied and no definite defect was found, so no supplement is filed. The literal field was unavailable and is unchecked.

findings.problem: s0271’s 漢祖 is extracted as Han Gaozu with a BC 202–195 window. However, 是以明、章之際 makes it the founder of Eastern Han, and Hou Hanshu 光武帝紀 records the matching executions for 度田不實 in 建武十六年秋九月 (AD 40). Gaozu has no such event.
findings.action: Send p133 to identity repair as Emperor Guangwu (光武帝, temple name 世祖), and keep the 漢祖 surface. Re-date claim-761 to the executions, westernYear AD 40 (建武十六年), and replace claim-807 and hints-p133 so they no longer use BC 202–195. If the identity is kept as Gaozu, flag the speaker’s anecdote as a misattribution instead of dating it to Gaozu’s reign.
